title: Deposit automation for restaurant bookings
thesis: Independent restaurants already pay for booking software and will pay for deposits.
note: The straightforward case: complaint plus observed spending plus a named gap.

evidence.title: Restaurant pays for booking software that cannot take deposits
evidence.body: We pay 180 a month for our booking system and it still cannot take a deposit, so we eat the loss every weekend.

evidence.title: Second site pays a separate tool purely for deposits
evidence.body: We bolted on a payments tool at 45 a month purely to hold deposits, and it does not talk to the booking system.

evidence.title: Trade body reports the cost of no-shows
evidence.body: A survey of member restaurants put the annual cost of no-shows in the low thousands per site.

evidence.title: Booking platform limits deposits to its enterprise tier
evidence.body: The feature is limited to their enterprise tier, well above what an independent site would pay.
